Our Story

From a Dutch hospital courtyard to the ocean breeze

Tucked inside the centuries-old Old Dutch Hospital on Hospital Street, 420 Crunch serves up a little crunch in the tropics — Asian grills, wok classics and comfort plates, best enjoyed with a cold drink and a sea view.

Come for lunch in the shade, stay for sunset at the ramparts. Everyone's welcome — families, travellers, four-legged friends on the terrace.
